visual.description: Warm off-white cream used as the primary page and footer background throughout the site.
Pure black used for body copy, footer links, and primary text content.
Near-black used for section headings and navigation category labels in uppercase.
Medium grey used for secondary footer text and utility links.
Same warm cream background visible in the nav bar at top-of-page state with logo and utility icons.
Black text for navigation category links in the top-of-page state.
Black used for nav links in the transparent/initial nav state.
Warm cream nav background that becomes the fixed opaque state after scrolling.
Black text for navigation links in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Black uppercase nav links in the scrolled nav state.
Very deep navy-black dominant color of the full-bleed hero video sections, part of the brand's dark cinematic visual language.
Black border used on the subscribe button outline and accessibility skip-link button.
Cream surface used for the product grid section and footer area, consistent with page background.
